scripts.build:pages: VITE_BASE=/${npm_package_name}/ tsc -b && VITE_BASE=/${npm_package_name}/ vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html && touch dist/.nojekyll && printf '%s\n' node_modules dist > dist/.gitignore
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && npx --yes gh-pages -d dist --nojekyll -t -f -m "deploy: GitHub Pages"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
